install.p2: Each GitHub release has one archive per platform, named `tmaegis_<version>_<os>_<arch>`: `.zip` for Windows and `.tar.gz` for Linux and macOS. It also has `checksums.txt` with the SHA-256 of every archive. The Downloads page shows these files with their hashes. The archive contains the `tmaegis` binary, the rules, the plugins and the licence files. Verify the download before you run it.

rules-format.p2: The rule explorer on this site lists every rule. `tmaegis rules export` produces the same catalogue as JSON.
